defects: (a) THE DELETE FORM NOT FOLLOWED, BEFORE THE SEAL. While writing the suite the seat ran a scratch command that appended nothing to an empty file under relay tools/ (tools/b638_checks.py.part2.txt) and removed it at once with a delete naming its absolute path but not verified with test -e in the same command, as the house delete form (b537, standing) orders. The file was the seat's own, empty, never tracked or staged; nothing else was touched. Declared on the face, section (0).

(b) THE GLOSSARY'S READ RUN BEFORE ITS RENDERER LANDED. The record tool's glossary_read was run at Component 1, right after the glossary's commit (relay 154d4bdc); it reads the glossary through the generator's renderer, which lands at Component 3, so it refused with nothing written. It ran after the generator's commit (relay 7848d8be) and banked data/b638_glossary.txt there; the order of the subcommands, not their output, was the seat's slip.

(c) A TRANSIENT REMOTE READ AT THE CENSUS. The census reads' first run (Component 4) read SIDE-trivium and SIDE-yang-mills-formation empty twice each (its own one retry), so their current tags read as none and the bank printed two moved tags; the run is kept whole as relay data/b638_census_attempt1.txt and its json. Each remote was read directly once (its main and its tag equal to v0.5's cell), and the reads re-ran alone, 38 reads, one per repository, no tag moved. The ferry's one ls-remote per repository is exceeded for those two repositories across the two runs, the first run's figures superseded.
short: (a) a scratch delete before the seal not verified in the same command, the file the seat's own and empty
(b) the glossary’s read run before its renderer landed, refused with nothing written, banked after the generator’s commit
(c) a transient empty remote read of two kernels at the census reads, the first run kept as its attempt, the direct reads equal to v0.5, the reads re-run alone
